title.zh: 在曼达卢永市Addition Hills描笼涯设立综合学校，名称为Addition Hills综合学校，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Establishing An Integrated School in Barangay Addition Hills, City of Mandaluyong to Be Known as Addition Hills Integrated School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing An Integrated School in Barangay Addition Hills, City of Mandaluyong to Be Known as Addition Hills Integrated School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2012/ra_10336_2012.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Establishment of an Integrated School. - There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, an integrated school in Barangay Addition Hills, City of Mandaluyong, National Capital Region to be known as Addition Hills Integrated School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Addition Hills Integrated School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication on in the Official Gazette.
